items.title: Bill Kirchner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2021
items.q: Well you know Duke Ellington used to carry a little notebook on him at all times so he could write down ideas when they came to him

ctx.x: Isn’t that so interesting, you don’t have to be sitting at the piano or score paper or Finale or whatever, they just seem to have this way of presenting themselves. And I know I’ve lost some ideas — walking the dog and I get this idea and yeah, by the time I get home it may be gone.

Well you know Duke Ellington used to carry a little notebook on him at all times so he could write down ideas when they came to him, no matter when they came or where he was when they came, which I think is a good idea, especially if you were Duke Ellington.
